subject: Revert the default PID file back to the real default (#275)
reason: The change edits only a comment in valkey.conf, correcting the documented default PID file path from /var/run/valkey.pid back to /var/run/redis.pid. No C source, config default, or runtime behaviour changes; the server's actual pidfile handling in src/config.c and src/server.c is untouched, so the two builds are behaviourally identical and no scenario can exercise a difference.
